gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-catamaran: Catamaran curves loosely and openly, never feeling clamped. Balsamiq Sans draws spaghetti-like lines of constant width that give headings their bold, expressive swagger, while the plain sans body simply stays friendly and out of the way.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Hand-cut and a bit cheeky, Balsamiq Sans keeps a single-weight outline feel in every curve it makes. Chiron Hei HK, a plain sans, brings a modern, businesslike finish.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-commissioner: Expressive from the first letter, Balsamiq Sans holds one stencil-like weight with no pinched curves. Commissioner, a smooth sans-serif, would feel lost if the heading shrank or it grew too large, since each does its best work at its own scale.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic reads smoothly, with no closed-up bowls to snag on and every stroke carrying the same visual weight. Balsamiq Sans, bold and expressive, adds the pair's strongest quality: a loud, hand-cut headline voice over a contemporary text face.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-dotgothic16: Chunky, bold and unfussy, Balsamiq Sans never pinches a curve. DotGothic16, a plain sans, offers wide channels into each counter and a tube-like thickness, where the heading brings the showy energy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-doto: No pressure swell ever softens Balsamiq Sans at a corner. Doto, a sans, leaves wide margins around each glyph and generous mouths on round letters, so longer text keeps feeling modern and approachable.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-el-messiri: Clean and modern, the pair splits its character: Balsamiq Sans runs bold and expressive with strokes as constant as bent wire. El Messiri, a plain sans, offers the mild swelling of a worn felt marker and a wide opening in its c.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-electrolize: Balsamiq Sans curves never thin out at the turns, giving every heading a bold, expressive, wire-like line. Electrolize, a sans, counters with an open-jawed c like pliers.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-elms-sans: Modern and contemporary, Elms Sans uses a pressure-free, ballpoint line. Balsamiq Sans brings its bold, stencil-cut weight and expressive curves, and that gap between them is the pair's strongest quality, with a see-through s in the plain sans.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans reads cleanly because its gaps keep c from ever looking like o. Balsamiq Sans bends its strokes like a paperclip above it, loud against the plain sans.
